claimed_seed_audit.interpretation: Different apertures use distinct NumPy Generator seeds and no shared scene realisation. H2 and H3 reuse a stream for the same aperture, so their forward predictions are paired.

equalised_first_16.note: The claimed calculation treats H2 and H3 as independent even though its seed schedule pairs them. The paired result includes their covariance.

native_first_16.note: The claimed calculation treats H2 and H3 as independent even though its seed schedule pairs them. The paired result includes their covariance.

scene_noise_spread.interpretation_limit: bias_ladder already generates a new synthetic scene in every replicate, so its replicate SD already contains this synthetic scene-to-scene component. This ratio cannot quantify how much larger real ROI-to-ROI heterogeneity is without reading real data.
